en.summary: Alibaba announced a partnership with Apple on October 31 to integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, allowing users in China to access Qwen's text and image understanding and content generation capabilities through Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence. en.title: Anthropic IPO filing reveals nearly $900 billion in hidden debt
en.summary: Anthropic has filed IPO prospectus documents, and Bloomberg reports the company plans to take on nearly $900 billion in debt to fund servers, buildings and power. Its balance sheet shows $117.5 billion in liabilities against $112 billion in cash, while lease obligations and off-balance-sheet commitments such as data center, power and GPU purchase agreements are not directly reflected. Anthropic plans to cover these liabilities by growing revenue and raising capital.
en.reason: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals nearly $900 billion in planned debt for servers, buildings and power, against $117.5 billion of balance-sheet liabilities and $112 billion in cash, with off-balance-sheet obligations worrying Wall Street.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实验显示，Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 仅用约 $1,000 算力，从 Mozilla 已发布未推送的修复中逆向漏洞，最快 12 小时让 Firefox 用户仅访问网页即泄露文件。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.
